---
title: "Demo B: own bridge on plain webR"
engine: markdown
---

This demo uses our own small bridge on top of webR (no quarto-live). Drag the person: the value in the code changes, **exactly that code** runs in R in your browser, and the equation is filled with values formatted by R.

The force on the person is $F = -k\,(x_1 - L_0)$.

::: {#demo-b-figure}
:::

```{.r #demo-b-code}
x1 <- 3
k  <- 2
L0 <- 2
F  <- -k * (x1 - L0)
```

::: {#demo-b-eq}
:::

::: {#demo-b-stats .small}
Loading R in your browser…
:::

```{=html}
<script type="module">
import { d3 } from "../lib/js/kit/index.js";
import { draw, interact } from "../lib/js/figures/spring1.js";
import { createBridge } from "../lib/js/live/bridge.js";
import { createLiveEquation } from "../lib/js/live/liveeq.js";

// Figure: draws immediately (before R is ready), without a force yet
const svg = d3.select("#demo-b-figure").append("svg");
let state = { x: 3, L0: 2, F: NaN };
draw(svg, state);

// Equation template: {{expr}} slots are evaluated and formatted in R
const eq = createLiveEquation(
  document.getElementById("demo-b-eq"),
  String.raw`F = -k\,(x_1 - L_0) = -{{k}}\,({{x1}} - {{L0}}) = {{F}}\ \mathrm{N}`,
  { colors: { x1: "hn-q-pen1", F: "hn-q-pen3" } });

const statsEl = document.getElementById("demo-b-stats");
const codeEl = document.querySelector("#demo-b-code code");

const bridge = await createBridge({
  codeEl,
  inputs: ["x1"],
  colors: { x1: "hn-q-pen1" },
  slots: eq.slots,
  onResult(result, stats) {
    if (result.error) { statsEl.textContent = "R error: " + result.error; return; }
    state = { ...state, F: Number(result.slots.F) };
    draw(svg, state);
    eq.render(result.slots);
    const recent = stats.evalMs.slice(-30);
    const avg = recent.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / recent.length;
    statsEl.innerHTML = `webR loaded in <b>${(stats.initMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s</b>. ` +
      `Drag events: <b>${stats.sent}</b>, evaluated in R: <b>${stats.evaluated}</b>, ` +
      `skipped (R was busy): <b>${stats.skipped}</b>; R time per update (last 30): ` +
      `average <b>${avg.toFixed(0)} ms</b>, max <b>${Math.max(...recent).toFixed(0)} ms</b>`;
    window.hnBridgeReady = true;
    window.hnBridgeStats = stats;
  },
});

bridge.run({ x1: state.x });   // first evaluation with the initial value

interact(svg, state, (s) => {
  state = { ...state, x: s.x };
  draw(svg, state);            // move at once, with the last known force
  bridge.run({ x1: s.x });
});
</script>
```
